name: Operations and Supply Chain Management Minor
intro: The minor in operations and supply chain management provides students with fundamental knowledge of operations and supply chains, the backbone of all businesses. This minor requires 20 units to complete. To enroll, students must have completed a minimum of 32 units of college-level course work and have a minimum overall GPA of at least 2.75.

courses.title: Designing Digital Processes and User Experience with AI
Managing a Small Business on the Internet
Optimization and Analytics for Better Decisions using GenAI
